description: This file defines a React functional component 'WorkbenchLoader' which manages the user interface for loading, displaying, and interacting with Playwright trace files within a web application. It handles file uploads, URL parameters, network requests, service worker communication, and various UI states related to trace visualization.

classes.name: TraceModel
classes.description: A data model representing the trace data structure used within the trace viewer application.

methods.name: processTraceFiles
methods.description: Processes selected trace files, generates a URL for the trace, updates the URL query parameter, and updates relevant state variables.

methods.name: fetchTrace
methods.description: Fetches context data for the trace from the server and updates the trace model.
